description.zh: 诊断任务 ID。与 TraceId/TaskId 至少需提供其中之一，两者均缺失时 API 将返回错误
description.en: The diagnostic task ID. You must specify at least one of TraceId and TaskId. If neither is specified, the API returns an error.

description.zh: 诊断链路 ID。与 TraceId/TaskId 至少需提供其中之一，两者均缺失时 API 将返回错误
description.en: The diagnostic trace ID. You must specify at least one of TraceId and TaskId. If neither is specified, the API returns an error.

descriptions.zh: ><notice>请确保使用该接口前开通了四层加速服务></notice>1. 调用 GenerateTraceDiagnose 获取诊断链接 2. 在浏览器中打开链接完成客户端诊断 3. 调用 ListTraceTasks 获取 TaskId/TraceId 4. 调用本接口获取报告
descriptions.en: ><notice>Make sure that you have activated the Layer 4 acceleration service before calling this operation.></notice>1. Call GenerateTraceDiagnose to obtain a diagnostic link. 2. Open the link in a browser to complete client-side diagnostics. 3. Call ListTraceTasks to obtain the TaskId or TraceId. 4. Call this operation to retrieve the report.
